title: Herb Infused Korean Chicken Skewers
description: Grassy and snappy Korean dish featuring tamarind paste, this recipe is a perfect blend of adventurous flavors, served on a slate tile vessel and is FODMAP friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together tamarind paste, soy sauce, brown sugar, garlic-infused oil, ginger, sesame oil, and black pepper.
Add the chicken to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated chicken onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 15 minutes.
While the chicken is cooking, mix the chopped scallions and cilantro in a small bowl.
After 15 minutes, remove the chicken from the oven and increase the oven temperature to broil.
Broil the chicken for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until slightly charred.
Remove the chicken from the oven and garnish with the scallion and cilantro mixture.
Serve the herb infused Korean chicken skewers on a slate tile vessel.
